notes.title: Taste Match
notes.text: See how your taste compares with other members. Tap the match score on their profile to see your shared favorites and topics.

notes.title: Sorting
notes.text: Sort Progress and Continue Watching by title, release date, rating and more with the new sort button.

notes.title: Episode Lists
notes.text: Add episodes and seasons to your lists. Tap Manage lists in the episode menu, or the lists icon on the seasons screen.

notes.title: Person Credits Details
notes.text: Tap Shows, Movies or From My History on a person page to browse all their credits, filtered by department.

notes.title: Monthly Calendar
notes.text: Switch the calendar to a monthly view with the toggle at the top. Tap any day to see what's releasing.

notes.title: UI Refresh
notes.text: The app has a fresh new look with updated colors, icons and typography!

notes.title: Month in Review
notes.text: VIP members get a recap of last month on Home during the first week of each month. Tap it to see your stats.

notes.title: Today
notes.text: See what your friends watched, rated and commented on in the last 24 hours. Tap Today on Home and flip through it story by story.

notes.title: Smart Lists
notes.text: Smart lists can now pull from All titles, your Watchlist or your Library, and mix shows and movies in one list.

notes.title: Linked Details
notes.text: Person bios, trivia and sentiment summaries now link straight to the cast and crew they mention. Tap a name to jump to their page.
